name: Pumpkin Scramble
original_name: パンプキン・スクランブル
source:
I'm still a long way off from my payday, but my current situation is undeniably getting worse and worse. 
In order to break out of this state, I came up with a plan.
That is, a battle tournament on Halloween night, with a cash prize!
...However, the prize money is won by drawing the lucky ticket in a packet of candy.
So!! I'll do whatever it takes to get the prize money and escape this financial rut!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909132648/http://sytry.org/p_s/]official website[/url]]
translation:
我距离发薪日还有很长的路要走，但不可否认的是，我目前的情况正在变得越来越糟。
为了摆脱这种状态，我想出了一个计划。
那就是万圣节之夜的一场战斗锦标赛，还有现金奖励！
……不过，奖金是通过抽取一包糖果中的幸运券来赢得的。
所以！！我会不惜一切代价获得奖金并摆脱这种财务困境！

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909132648/http://sytry.org/p_s/]官网[/url]]
